volumes.title: Pearl Harbor
volumes.blurb: From the morning Japan's carriers slip out of the Kurils to the midget submarines creeping toward Oahu in the dark.
volumes.intro: Twelve days to war, told as they happened.

volumes.title: The Bulge
volumes.blurb: Hitler's last gamble in the West, from the dawn barrage in the Ardennes to the American armies closing on Houffalize.
volumes.note: First dispatch 16 Dec 2026 at 6:30 a.m. Mountain. Days appear here as they post.

volumes.title: Anzio
volumes.blurb: Allied troops land behind the German line in Italy, then must hold a narrow beachhead under the guns.
volumes.note: Begins with the 22 January 1944 landing, posting from 22 Jan 2027. Days appear here as they post.

volumes.title: Remagen
volumes.blurb: An American patrol finds a bridge over the Rhine still standing, and the army races to hold it.
volumes.note: Posts 7 to 17 March 2027 on the real dates. Days appear here as they post.

volumes.title: Okinawa
volumes.blurb: The last great battle of the Pacific, and the radar picket destroyers that stood in the path of the kamikazes.
volumes.note: Posts 1 to 16 April 2027 on the real dates. Days appear here as they post.
